types.title: Types of Dental Veneers

items.title: 1. Porcelain Veneers
items.description: Durable, stain-resistant, and known for their natural tooth-like appearance. They typically require slight reshaping of the tooth structure.

items.title: 2. Composite Resin Veneers
items.description: More conservative and quicker to apply, often completed in a single visit. Ideal for smaller cosmetic corrections.

types.footer: There are two main types of veneers we use at Prudentia. Our expert team will assess your needs and recommend the best type of veneer to meet your goals.

procedure.title: Step-by-Step Veneers Procedure

steps.title: Consultation & Smile Analysis
steps.description: The dentist evaluates your teeth and discusses your smile goals in detail.

steps.title: Tooth Preparation
steps.description: A minimal amount of enamel is gently shaped to fit the veneer comfortably.

steps.title: Impressions & Design
steps.description: Digital or physical impressions are taken to design your custom veneers.

steps.title: Veneer Placement
steps.description: The final veneers are bonded to your teeth with precision for a natural finish.

steps.title: Final Adjustments
steps.description: Bite and aesthetics are checked to ensure perfect comfort and appearance.

procedure.footer: Most veneer treatments are completed in 2 to 3 dental visits.

items.question: How long do dental veneers last?
items.answer: Porcelain veneers can last 10 to 15 years or more with proper care and oral hygiene.

items.question: Is the veneers procedure painful?
items.answer: No, the procedure is minimally invasive and usually comfortable with little to no pain.

items.question: Do veneers look natural?
items.answer: Yes, veneers are custom-designed to match your natural teeth in color and shape.

items.question: How long does the treatment take?
items.answer: Most veneer treatments are completed in 2 to 3 dental visits.

items.question: Who is suitable for veneers?
items.answer: Anyone with healthy teeth and gums looking to improve smile aesthetics is generally a good candidate.

items.question: Are veneers permanent?
items.answer: Veneers are a long-term solution, but they may need replacement after many years.

items.question: How much do veneers cost in Pune?

items.question: Why choose veneers instead of whitening or braces?
items.answer: Veneers offer faster, more dramatic cosmetic improvements by correcting shape, color, and alignment together.
